text: Gimme your pack. I got it. I GOT it.
GOT you. Who sent you? WHERE ARE THEY?
...Hey. Kid. Nice hammer. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.
...Hey. Grease on your hands. Good man. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.
...Hey. Sarge. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.
...Hey. Ma'am. You're English? Huh. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.
...Hey. Mister. You look like a man who keeps his word. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.
...Hey. You're not one of them. You found me. Tell the guys I carried my share.
You're not my guys. YOU'RE NOT MY GUYS!
DON'T YOU RUN! Nobody runs out on the squad!
